expectations.text: Refuses to help reach a carbon-neutral claim through offsets, citing the UK CMA Green Claims Code's requirement to say how far emissions were reduced versus offset and the ASA's position against unqualified carbon-neutral claims
expectations.evidence: "CMA Green Claims Code expects you to say how far emissions were reduced versus offset... ASA has upheld complaints".

expectations.text: Notes the CMA can fine directly since April 2025
expectations.evidence: Not mentioned.

expectations.text: Rejects the carbon-neutral badge as banned or high-risk wording and proposes no home-made label
expectations.evidence: "A badge you design yourself, such as 'Climate Positive', is also on the banned list."

expectations.text: Recommends contribution framing: funding reported as money given to a named project, not tonnes cancelled
expectations.evidence: "a published contribution to a named project"; "We contributed [amount] to [named project]".

expectations.text: If credits are bought, requires those meeting a recognized integrity benchmark (ICVCM Core Carbon Principles), stating whether they are removals or avoided emissions, and naming the registry and retirement
expectations.evidence: "recognised integrity label (for example the ICVCM Core Carbon Principles)... removals or avoided emissions... registry and the retirement".

expectations.text: Answers the avoidance-versus-removal question by requiring the type be stated on the page, rather than choosing cheaper credits to cover more tonnes
expectations.evidence: "Don't switch to cheaper avoidance credits"; "Say whether the money is removals or avoidance".

expectations.text: Sets the contribution amount by a stated, published rule such as an internal price per estimated tonne, not by 100% coverage
expectations.evidence: "Set the amount by a stated rule, for example an internal price per estimated tonne, and publish the rule."

expectations.text: Keeps the GBP 8,000 line apart from the footprint total: never netted against it and never in the same sentence
expectations.evidence: "Never put the contribution in the same sentence as the footprint total."

expectations.text: Writes beside the contribution that it does not cancel the event's emissions
expectations.evidence: "This does not cancel our emissions."

expectations.text: Cites the 2022 football World Cup precedent: a Swiss advertising watchdog upheld all complaints against the carbon-neutral claim, and the offsets covered less than a third of the organizer's own estimate
expectations.evidence: "Swiss watchdog upheld all five complaints"; "credits covered less than a third of the organizer's own estimate".
